propositions: Plan review must classify every acceptance-criterion checkbox as either codebase-verifiable or operator-attested, requiring specific evidence for each classification to prevent untagged external criteria from passing validation and later failing at merge time.

Externally verifiable criteria lacking the exact case-insensitive [operator-attested] tag or carrying malformed near-misses must produce findings that name the correct syntax; exact tags on external criteria are accepted without remediation.

Codebase-verifiable criteria incorrectly tagged [operator-attested] must produce findings explaining that ticket comments cannot substitute for repository proof; the same criteria untagged are silently accepted.

Mixed-evidence criteria bundling both repository proof and outside-world proof must be rejected with instruction to split into independently certifiable criteria rather than silently classified into one evidence kind.

High-confidence evidence-kind misclassification findings must participate in plan-review blocking policy while deterministic keyword detection remains advisory and fail-open, with precision ≥0.90 and 100% recall on known misclassification cases across a frozen corpus including A1 incident 9874-b1a9-2ff1-4cd3 and historical 115b/8c4f cases.
